cannons.name: Burst Cannon
cannons.role: Highest attack speed; the farming pick.

cannons.name: Freeze Cannon
cannons.role: Freezes bosses, but X-20 bosses are immune.
cannons.note: The drafts said it locks down stage bosses without the X-20 exception.

cannons.name: Knockback Cannon
cannons.role: Pushes waves back from the fortress.

kits.name: Dangerous Wrench Kit
kits.role: Extra fortress attack speed and damage.
kits.note: The drafts' 1.5% HP drain per second is unconfirmed.

kits.name: Red Barrier Kit
kits.role: Needed past stage 50, together with Zelos and his exclusive weapon.

kits.name: Squeak Droid
kits.role: Used for Merfolk's Ambush farming. Its effect (drafts: 40% DEF shred) is unconfirmed.

facilities.name: Kitchen
facilities.role: Turns basic food into higher-grade food for hero levels.

facilities.name: Sauna
facilities.role: Gives passive XP to heroes placed inside.
facilities.note: The drafts said it fills a fortress rank EXP pool.

facilities.name: Gear Factory
facilities.role: Cannon equipment and Barrage Crystals for Augmentation.

facilities.name: Smelter
facilities.role: Turns ores into weapons and trinkets.

facilities.name: Arcane Workshop
facilities.role: Potentials, equipment rerolls and World Leaf materials.

facilities.name: Engine Room
facilities.role: Makes Fuel, Engine Oil and engines.

facility_notes.text: Hero level affects how fast heroes work in facilities.
4 worker slots per facility and rarity speed multipliers of 1.15-1.75.

engines.text: Engines are made in the Engine Room from Fuel and Engine Oil.
8 engine slots, slot 2 at Augmentation 5, and the other slot gates.

machina.text: Machina Engineering unlocks after stage 50-20. Blueprints craft Precision Parts.
A 4x4 grid, a 1.25x connector bonus, and the part types and values.
